name: CreditGuard
summary: CreditGuard is a complete credit scoring platform powered by Machine Learning, covering the entire ML workflow — from data processing and model training to real-time prediction and interactive visualization.
description: I developed CreditGuard as an end-to-end Machine Learning project focused on credit risk assessment. The platform includes in-depth model interpretability analysis (Feature Importance, stability, bias-variance), experiment tracking with MLflow, a real-time prediction interface, and an interactive dashboard built with React. The goal was to deliver an intelligent and reliable solution capable of accurately assessing credit risk while providing clear insights into the model's decision-making process.
outcome: Built a complete ML pipeline from data processing to real-time prediction
Implemented model interpretability analysis (Feature Importance, Bias-Variance, Stability)
Integrated MLflow for experiment tracking and model versioning
Developed an interactive React dashboard with training results visualization
Achieved 87.6% accuracy and 94.3% ROC-AUC with Random Forest
highlight: From Data to Credit Risk: A complete ML-powered credit scoring platform
imageCaption: Interactive ML Dashboard showing Random Forest training results with real-time metrics — 87.6% Accuracy, 94.3% ROC-AUC, and hyperparameter tuning via GridSearch.

name: AI Chat Assistant
summary: An AI-powered assistant concept designed to answer frequent questions, guide users, and automate first-line support.
description: This case study demonstrates how conversational UI can be integrated into a modern web product to reduce repetitive support work and improve responsiveness.
outcome: A scalable first-response layer for common support questions
A polished example of AI integration inside a modern web product
A showcase use case combining frontend, API thinking, and automation
highlight: Conversational AI interface for support automation

name: TeleRetention AI
summary: TeleRetention AI is a machine learning project that predicts customer churn for telecom operators by analyzing customer behavior and subscription data. The objective is to identify at-risk customers and support proactive retention strategies, helping reduce churn and improve customer loyalty.
description: This project aims to predict customer churn in the telecommunications sector using Machine Learning techniques. By analyzing customer demographics, service usage patterns, billing information, and contract details, the model identifies subscribers who are at high risk of leaving the operator.
outcome: Predicted customer churn risk using machine learning models.
Identified high-risk subscribers to support retention strategies.
Reduced false positives through feature engineering and model optimization.
Delivered an interactive dashboard for churn analysis and visualization.

name: Blockchain Dataset Certification and Rating DApp
summary: A full-stack blockchain DApp that lets users publish datasets on-chain, rate them transparently, and earn token-based rewards in a local Ethereum environment.
description: Developed a decentralized application (DApp) for transparent dataset certification and evaluation. Users can register datasets on the blockchain, rate them from 1 to 5, and earn token-based rewards. The solution combines a Solidity smart contract, React frontend, FastAPI backend, Ganache blockchain, and MetaMask integration to ensure secure, traceable, and tamper-resistant dataset management.
outcome: Built a working full-stack blockchain DApp for dataset certification and rating
Implemented on-chain dataset storage and transparent rating logic
Prevented duplicate voting using wallet-address-based validation
Calculated average dataset ratings directly in the smart contract
Integrated MetaMask for wallet connection and transaction signing
Added backend endpoints for health checks, statistics, sync, and leaderboard support
Tested the application on a local Ganache Ethereum network
metrics: Duplicate voting blocked: 1 vote maximum per wallet per dataset
Token reward: 10 internal tokens per valid rating
Blockchain network: Ganache local Ethereum chain
highlight: Decentralized dataset certification and transparent rating on a local Ethereum blockchain

name: BrainWave AI: EEG Signal Classification and Analysis
summary: Developed a machine learning model for EEG signal classification by combining signal preprocessing, feature extraction, and predictive modeling. The solution analyzes brainwave data to detect and classify neural activity patterns with high accuracy.
description: NeuroVision is a machine learning project focused on the analysis and classification of Electroencephalography (EEG) signals. The system processes brainwave data, extracts relevant features, and applies machine learning algorithms to identify different mental states or neurological patterns.
outcome: Processed and analyzed EEG signals for brain activity classification.
Extracted relevant signal features to improve model performance.
Classified neural activity patterns using machine learning algorithms.
Visualized EEG trends and classification results for interpretation.

name: Saniti – Smart Agricultural Assistant
summary: Developed Saniti, a lightweight offline mobile application that uses AI, weather forecasts, satellite data, and farmer inputs to generate personalized crop calendars and support smarter agricultural planning.
description: Saniti is an AI-powered mobile application designed to support farmers in optimizing crop planning and agricultural decision-making. The application works offline and combines satellite data, weather information, and farmer-provided inputs to generate a personalized cultivation calendar.
outcome: Generated personalized crop calendars using AI-driven recommendations.
Combined satellite, weather, and farmer-provided data for decision support.
Enabled offline access for farmers in low-connectivity regions.
Improved agricultural planning through data-driven insights.
metrics: Supported Data Sources: Satellite + Weather + Farmer Inputs
Target Users: Farmers and Agricultural Cooperatives

Compared multiple machine learning algorithms to select the best-performing model.
